history.description: A soft, matte, round glow sits behind the phone with even rays all around on deep ink. Its colour and motion shift between four moods: a calm blue glow, a cyan heartbeat, warm breathing waves, and fine violet streaks.

definitions.name: model
definitions.description: Which Gemini model's light shows behind the phone, 0 to 3 (default 0), continuous so it can be tweened: 0 gemini-4-hydrogen (calm blue wash, slow rays), 1 gemini-decision-1 (cyan, leans left, pulses once per second), 2 gemini-3.8-flash-tts (sun, concentric sound waves), 3 gemini-4-neon (violet, fine streaks being written). In-between values crossfade colour and motion. The landing sets it from scroll.
